name: Workflow Phases
description: For analyzing conversation transcripts with workflow phases
componentIdentificationPrompt:
Classify each message/step into one of these workflow phases:

## Workflow Phases

| # | Phase | Color | Description |
|---|-------|-------|-------------|
| 1 | UNDERSTAND | blue | Comprehending the task requirements and constraints |
| 2 | EXPLORE | teal | Gathering information from codebase, searching, reading files |
| 3 | ANALYZE | rose | Considering approaches, identifying root causes, weighing tradeoffs |
| 4 | PLAN | amber | Creating actionable steps, tracking todos, designing solution |
| 5 | IMPLEMENT | violet | Writing/editing code, making changes |
| 6 | VERIFY | lime | Running tests, builds, lints, type-checks |
| 7 | COMPLETE | slate | Summarizing changes, final message, cleanup |
